name: Dress
overview: Scripture reveals that dress holds both practical and symbolic significance, beginning with Adam and Eve who made aprons from fig leaves and were later clothed by God in coats of skins, signifying divine provision and covering. Clothing also served as a mark of honor and identity, as seen when Joseph gave his brothers changes of raiment, and the detailed garments prescribed for priests to minister in holiness and beauty. Additionally, there are clear ethical instructions regarding clothing, such as the prohibition against holding a neighbor's garment overnight as a pledge, underscoring respect and fairness in interpersonal relationships.
